eps.t: Ik zie, ik zie, wat jij ook ziet

eps.d: The forces of nature foil the animal's plan to grab The Secret.
The Bluffers are up in arms when Clandestino makes a radio broadcast. Is the greedy tyrant calling for help to win his struggle against the animals?
The castle watchdog defects to help the woodland creatures.
A mysterious treasure map tricks Clandestino into destroying his castle!
When Clandestino's robot, Sillycone, develops ricks that reproduce themselves into a never ending road, he is ordered to aim them at the forest of Bluffoonia to destroy it once an for all!

eps.t: Waarom een verre vriend als je een goede buur hebt
eps.d: When Regal the Eagle brings the news that Clandestino hates the colour Green, the Bluffers assume that this is the reason that he is trying to destroy the forest. An operation is mounted to repaint the whole forest another colour!
When Clandestino tries to destroy their forest home, the Bluffers take to the sky in a hot air balloon in an attempt to foil his plan.
